title: Starknify
tagline: Starknify is an analytic tool that I am building to make users view data and information on the starknet ecosystem, from addresses, to live activities and many more.

prizes.placement: Pool for projects which use Dynamic
prizes.title: Pool for projects which use Dynamic

description: This project helps you to fetch for any information think of just any thing on chain, you can access it with starknify. From block timestamp to nonce to storage root to Transaction vaules and many more can be accessed through Starknify. You can also access specific chain data as this can be so helpful for account recovery and establishing the truth.
how_its_made: The project is  a NextJs Application which I embedded streamlite data visualization app into it. I am exploring the snowflake ware house for starknet to fetch chain data also I am working with the herodotus cloud api to fetch chain specific data. I made data fetching so dynamic, tailored, unique and stress free for users.
